item.title: Trump merchandise stores are closing: 'He has peaked'
item.description: At least four Trump merchandise stores have closed this year. Store owners say with Trump in his final term, there isn't as much to fire up his consumer fan base and sales have softened.

item.title: How long does it take to save up for a starter home? Twice as long as it did in 2019
item.description: A new analysis finds that the average renter household now needs 16 years to save for a down payment and closing costs. Rising rents and other costs have consumed a growing share of household budgets.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Supreme Court upholds pause on Trump's anti-trans prison policy
item.description: The Supreme Court ruled Wednesday that the Trump administration has to continue providing gender-affirming care to inmates in federal prisons as litigation on efforts to change the policy continues.

item.title: 2025 policing trend: Fewer serious crimes, more minor arrests
item.description: Arrests for more minor offenses, including vagrancy, rose in the U.S., even as violent crime rates dropped to historic lows, according to an analysis from criminal justice reform advocacy group FWD.us
